parameters.query:
INSERT INTO customers (phone, name) VALUES ($1, $2)
ON CONFLICT (phone) DO UPDATE SET name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.name, customers.name);
SELECT role, text FROM messages WHERE phone = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10;
INSERT INTO messages (phone, role, text) VALUES ($1, 'user', $2);

nodes.notes: SWAP-POINT / LLM — local Ollama gemma3:4b. Swap the URL/model for any cloud LLM. format:json + low temp keep output parseable.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO appointments (phone, service_id, requested_time, status, notes)
VALUES ($1, (SELECT id FROM services WHERE name = $2), $3, 'pending', $4);

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('Parse LLM reply + Fallback').first().json.phone, $('Parse LLM reply + Fallback').first().json.service, $('Parse LLM reply + Fallback').first().json.requested_time, 'Booking request via WhatsApp receptionist' ] }}
